subject.title: fix(auth): allow GitHub-authorized users through Access

question: Should Krillswitch intentionally allow every identity from enabled Cloudflare Access providers to reach the application, with GitHub-backed Krillswitch role checks becoming the sole human authorization boundary?
rationale: The diff deliberately removes an operator-configurable perimeter restriction; whether the resulting broader ingress policy is acceptable depends on maintainers' intended trust boundary and deployment model, not on a mechanical code check.

options.title: Require endpoint and deployment proof
options.body: Before merge, verify in a production-like Access setup that an authenticated identity without a Krillswitch role cannot access any privileged browser endpoint, while a role-assigned external collaborator can complete GitHub sign-in.

options.title: Accept the app-level boundary
options.body: Approve the broader Access policy as the intended trust model and document that every enabled Access identity provider is within the pre-authentication audience.

recommendation.title: Require endpoint and deployment proof
recommendation.body: Before merge, verify in a production-like Access setup that an authenticated identity without a Krillswitch role cannot access any privileged browser endpoint, while a role-assigned external collaborator can complete GitHub sign-in.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed authorization-boundary change and are the only identified repository member connected to this specific implementation.
